concepts.why: Name is the words all four passages share; all four notes are exact quotations of the Berean text; Romans 1:23 sits beside the Old Testament passages without any claim of fulfilment.

Each passage records an image made; Exodus 32:8, Isaiah 44:17, Daniel 3:5 and Revelation 13:14-15 also say it is worshiped. Deuteronomy 27:15 and 1 Kings 12:28 carry the making and the setting up more than the worship, which is thin but not a fault; all six notes are exact.

Plain label from the texts' own title; all five notes are exact; New Testament passages only, so no grouping says Old Testament firstborn texts point to it; Colossians 1:15 and Romans 8:29 are quoted, not glossed, so no tradition's reading is imposed.

Name is the texts' own phrase; the three passages are bounded to the verses that name the face and veil; notes are exact; the grouping states no relation between Exodus and 2 Corinthians beyond the shared veil.
